central_unknown: Isaac Hajar's exact grid penalty (likely P21-P22 start) and how many positions he can recover on Sunday — plus whether Lando Norris's 10-place grid penalty generates enough upside to justify a Final Fix chip or 2x boost over Antonelli.

meta_template.name: Antonelli x2 + Hajar + Mercedes + Red Bull/Ferrari

captains.label: Primary
captains.name: Kimi Antonelli
captains.reason: Consensus #1 pick across all channels. Topped FP2, expected to qualify front row and win the race. Six fastest laps in nine races this season. Estimated 30-35 points. Safe, high-floor option.

captains.label: Differential
captains.name: Isaac Hajar
captains.reason: Starting P21-P22 due to engine penalty. Could gain 12-14 positions with massive overtake points (estimated 24+ from positions gained alone). Strong candidate for Driver of the Day. Multiple channels note Autopilot chip is viable here as Hajar could challenge Antonelli for most points scored. Five straight top-6 finishes entering the weekend.

captains.label: Differential
captains.name: Lando Norris
captains.reason: 10-place grid penalty creates overtake opportunity. FanAmp ran the numbers: best case ~30 points on Sunday vs Antonelli's typical 35. Consensus is Norris is NOT worth the 2x boost and NOT worth a Final Fix chip. Better as a supporting asset alongside Antonelli if budget allows, but most channels advise against prioritizing him over Hajar.

buy.name: Isaac Hajar
buy.note: Must-have across all channels. Back-of-grid penalty means massive overtake and positions-gained points. Betting lines predict P8 finish from P22 start. Five consecutive top-6 finishes. Even worth a -10 hit to bring in per ZachGP.

buy.name: Arvid Lindblad
buy.note: Universal must-have. Needs only 1 point for max price rise of 0.6M. Racing Bulls looked strong in top 10 across FP1 and FP2. Best budget asset available — every single team should have him.

buy.name: Gabriel Bortoleto
buy.note: P10 in FP1. Audi brought Spa-spec rear wing. Needs 3 points for max price rise. Strong budget-building option and natural swap target if upgrading from Hulkenberg.

buy.name: Franco Colapinto
buy.note: Needs just 1 point for max 0.6M price rise. Was quicker Alpine in FP2. Best price-rise thresholds on the grid (-8 for minimum rise). Slightly expensive but elite budget builder.

consider.name: Liam Lawson
consider.note: Racing Bulls embedded in top 10 all weekend. Needs 6 points for max rise — easily attainable per FormulaFantasyHub. Cheaper alternative to Colapinto if budget is tight. Strong consistent option.

consider.name: Nico Hulkenberg
consider.note: Budget option for lower-budget teams. Audi have Spa-spec upgrades. Competitive in upper midfield but keeps teasing price rise without delivering. Consider swapping to Bortoleto.

consider.name: Esteban Ocon
consider.note: Scored 7+ points in every race this season. 6.4 overtakes per race, strong positions-gained numbers. Good consolation if 0.1M short of Colapinto. Low ownership differential.

consider.name: Oliver Bearman
consider.note: Has more random upside than Ocon per F1FantasyPolePosition. Needs 6 points for min price rise. Low ownership at 6.8% in top 500.

avoid: Lance Stroll — lives in P22 regardless of penalty; one week too early before Aston Martin upgrades in Hungary
Fernando Alonso — needs just 1 point for max price rise but zero trust from any channel; goal is to 'get home in time for World Cup final'
Valtteri Bottas — 3 DNFs in last 4 races; bottom of barrel only
George Russell — 1.2 seconds off Antonelli in FP2, complained about grip; risky at his premium price unless issues resolved overnight

chips.name: Autopilot
chips.reason: Strong consensus candidate this week. With Hajar starting P22 and potentially scoring 25+ points, he could challenge Antonelli for top scorer. Multiple channels (FormulaFantasyHub, F1FantasyPolePosition) are actively considering it. Best use case: Antonelli 2x for qualifying, Autopilot swaps to Hajar if he outscores on Sunday. FormulaFantasyHub explicitly titles video 'USE AUTOPILOT THIS WEEK'.

chips.name: Final Fix
chips.reason: FanAmp ran detailed numbers: even best-case Norris (P15→P5 with all overtakes) scores ~30 points vs Antonelli's typical 35. Consensus across channels is the upside isn't there. F1FantasyPolePosition calls Final Fix a 'break glass in case of emergency' chip — save it for a bigger opportunity.

chips.name: No Negative
chips.reason: FanAmp notes No Negative is 'always in play at Spa' due to unpredictable weather and potential DNFs. Not heavily discussed but flagged as relevant for this circuit's history of incidents.

chips.name: Wildcard
chips.reason: Not discussed as a candidate this week. Hungary upgrades next week from Aston Martin could reshape the meta.

George Russell overnight fix for lack of grip — 1.2s off Antonelli in FP2; impacts Mercedes constructor value
Charles Leclerc pace — 0.8s behind Hamilton in FP2; could data-mine like Silverstone or could genuinely be off pace
Pierre Gasly crash damage — Alpine expect him back Saturday but heavy FP2 shunt could affect qualifying
Oscar Piastri hydraulic pressure issue in FP1 — reliability concern for McLaren
Red Bull 'Macarena wing' removed — Verstappen looked comfortable and topped FP1; could be genuine front-row contender
Weather at Spa — microclimate means rain possible any session; 25% chance Sunday, increasing cloudiness
Red Bull constructor as differential — both Verstappen (podium contender) and Hajar (back-to-front drive) could deliver huge constructor points
arc: Belgium is the final race before the summer break setup begins with Hungary. Aston Martin are bringing upgrades to the Hungaroring, which could make Stroll and Alonso relevant assets for the first time this season. Teams should prioritize budget building this week via Lindblad, Colapinto, and Bortoleto price rises while exploiting Hajar's grid penalty for a potential monster score. The Red Bull constructor may emerge as a genuine alternative to Ferrari going forward if Verstappen maintains front-row pace and Hajar continues his top-6 form. Save the Final Fix chip — bigger opportunities likely coming in the second half of the season. Multiple channels note that the 4A template (bringing in Norris alongside Antonelli as a premium) is close to being viable but not quite justified this week; hold off one more race.
